{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Confirm total number of patients and count of severe
n_patients = len(df)
severe_count = df['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
fraction_severe = severe_count / n_patients

print(f"Total patients: {n_patients}")
print(f"Severe baseline: {severe_count}")
print(f"Fraction severe: {fraction_severe}")"}
